profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. describes itself as an observability platform built for the age of AI. Its website says the company offers observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, and calls itself the AI-powered observability leader. The site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A statement on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

Dynatrace, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under ticker DT, with SEC CIK number 0001773383. It also appears under the name DYNATRACE INC. Massachusetts legal exposure records list 191 entries associated with the company.
